title: DECISION: no DB row at blob upload time (Option C)
description: blob_upload_handler deliberately skips inserting an attachments DB row at upload time (Step 9 comment: 'intentionally omitted'). Three options: A) insert row at upload with message_id=NULL, link at Message/set; B) inline blob in JMAP request; C) write blob to disk only, insert DB row atomically with message row in insert_message_with_attachments. A rejected: orphan DB rows for abandoned uploads; linking via UPDATE leaves inconsistent state on Message/set failure. B rejected: defeats streaming upload, bloats JMAP request. C chosen: disk file is staging area; DB row written atomically with message. Trade-off: unreferenced blobs accumulate on disk and require future GC. Location: crates/kithd/src/blob.rs, crates/kith-store/src/lib.rs.
